original.statement: The unused cli-flag `--sidecar-istio-proxy-image` has been removed in Cilium 1.16.

decision.reason: [ev-e477115a445b] lists "The unused flag `sidecar-istio-proxy-image` has been removed" under the 1.16 upgrade notes' Removed Options. That supports a cli-flag subject named --sidecar-istio-proxy-image, with the leading -- added as the family convention requires, and a change type of removed. The note names no component, so leaving the component out is correct. The validators were inconclusive because the chart could not be fetched, so they neither prove nor contradict this.
